name: com.virgovillasbarbados/villa-search
title: Virgo Villas Barbados
description: Search luxury villas on the west coast of Barbados, check dates, price a stay and request a booking.

tools.name: search_villas
tools.description: Search the Virgo Villas Barbados collection of luxury holiday villas, apartments and estates on the west coast of Barbados. Filters combine (all must match), exactly as on the site's own villa search. With arrival and departure, booked villas are left out, each result says whether its calendar confirms the dates (available) or cannot confirm them (unknown: the team checks with the owner), and is priced for the whole stay including 13% local taxes. Without dates, results show the lowest nightly 'from' rate. Prices are estimates from published rates; the team confirms the price with the villa before anything is paid. Use get_villa for full details and check_availability for one villa's dates.

arrival.description: Arrival date as YYYY-MM-DD. Give it with departure to search by dates.

departure.description: Departure date as YYYY-MM-DD, the morning the guests leave. Stays of 1 to 90 nights.

guests.description: Number of guests, children and babies included. Only villas that sleep at least this many.

area.description: Area, estate, parish or villa name, for example Sandy Lane, Royal Westmoreland, Mullins or St Peter. Matches any part of a villa's name or place. Leave out to search everywhere.

collection.description: One of the site's collections: ocean-views (Ocean Views), beach-front-villas (Beachfront Properties), luxury-villas (Luxury Properties), apartments-townhouses (Apartments & Townhouses), tennis-golf (Tennis & Golf), romantic-secluded (Romantic & Secluded), ridge-and-country (Ridge & Country).

features.description: Must-haves; a villa needs every one: beachfront, private-pool (private or plunge pool), sea-view, tennis (tennis court), golf (golf on the doorstep), gym, media-room, all-ensuite (all bedrooms en-suite), video (has a video tour).

max_nightly_price.description: Highest 'from' price per night, in the chosen currency, before local taxes.

currency.description: Currency for prices and max_nightly_price. Rates are published in US dollars; GBP and CAD are converted at the day's reference rate.

sort.description: Order of results. With dates, price sorts use the stay total.

offset.description: How many matching villas to skip, for the next page of results.

tools.name: get_villa
tools.description: Full details of one villa: description, highlights, facilities, bedrooms, bathrooms, who it sleeps, minimum stay, location, photos, each bedroom option with its lowest rate, and the published seasonal nightly rates still to come. Give the villa's slug (from search_villas), its name, or its id. Rates are per night in the chosen currency before 13% local taxes.

villa.description: The villa's slug (for example alila), name (for example Alila) or numeric id.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check one villa for specific dates and price the stay. Availability is 'available' (the villa's live calendar shows every night free), 'booked' (with the booked nights) or 'unknown' (no current calendar; the team checks with the owner, so it is not booked). The estimate adds up the published nightly rates night by night, picks the bedroom option that sleeps the party, and includes 13% local taxes; it also reports the minimum stay. It is an estimate: the team confirms the exact price with the villa before anything is paid. Returns a link to the site's booking form with the stay filled in.

villa.description: The villa's slug, name or numeric id.

departure.description: Departure date as YYYY-MM-DD, the morning the guests leave.

guests.description: Number of guests, children included. Chooses the bedroom option to price; leave out for the smallest.

tools.name: list_search_options
tools.description: The values search_villas understands, with how many villas each has: areas and estates, parishes, collections and must-have features, plus the largest villa sizes. Use it to turn a guest's words into search filters.

tools.name: get_contact_details
tools.description: How to reach the Virgo Villas Barbados team: phone numbers for the UK, US and Canadian offices, email, postal address, and the pages where a guest sends an enquiry or a booking request. Enquiries and booking requests are sent by the guest from those pages; with the guest's approval, request_booking sends a booking request for them.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Send the guest's booking request for one villa and stay to the Virgo Villas Barbados team, in the guest's name, as the site's booking form does: the team replies to the guest's email, and the guest gets a copy. No sign-in needed: give the guest's email, and the site's spam filter checks the request, as it checks the form. (With a sign-in the guest approved, scope booking:request, the email they approved is used and no spam check is needed; see https://www.virgovillasbarbados.com/auth.md.) Use it only when the guest has asked to go ahead with exactly these details and has accepted the Booking Conditions (https://www.virgovillasbarbados.com/terms-conditions.html). It is a request, not a booking: the team checks availability and the exact price with the villa, and nothing is booked or paid until they confirm. Booked dates and stays under the minimum are refused rather than sent. One request per villa and stay: asking again returns the first answer.

villa.description: The villa's slug, name or numeric id.

departure.description: Departure date as YYYY-MM-DD, the morning the guests leave.

email.description: The guest's email address: the team replies to it and the guest's copy goes there. Required unless you are signed in with the guest's approval.

phone.description: The lead guest's phone number, with the country code.

notes.description: Anything else the guest wants the team to know (no links).

accept_booking_conditions.description: true only when the guest has read the Booking Conditions (https://www.virgovillasbarbados.com/terms-conditions.html) and accepted them.

assistant_name.description: Your name as the guest knows you (for example ChatGPT or Claude), shown to the team with the request.
